chapterInfo.content:
12
Ɔberempɔn ne ɔman no tukorɔ
1Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 2#Yes 6.9-10 Onipa ba, wote atuatefoɔ fie, nnipa a wɔwɔ ani a wɔde hunu adeɛ nanso wɔnhunu, na wɔwɔ aso a wɔde teɛ nanso wɔnteɛ; 3na atuatefoɔ fie ne wɔn. Na wo, onipa ba, yɛ otukorɔ adeɛ fa, na tu kɔ awia, wɔ wɔn anim, na tu firi wo tenabea kɔ baabi foforɔ, wɔn anim; ebia wɔbɛhunu; na asowuiɛ fie ne wɔn. 4Na yi wo nnoɔma firi adi sɛ ɔtukorɔ adeɛ awia, wɔn anim, na wo ara deɛ, firi adi anwummerɛ, sɛ atukɔfoɔ kɔ no no. 5Tu ɔfasuo no mu tokuro, wɔn anim, na fa mu firi adi. 6#Hes 24.24, 27 Wɔn anim ara na fa nnoɔma no to wo kɔn ho, na anim biri a, wode afiri adi. Kata w’ani na woanhunu asase no, na mede wo mayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ mama Israel fie.
7Ɛnna meyɛɛ saa, sɛdeɛ wɔhyɛɛ me no, meyii me nnoɔma firii adi sɛ otukorɔ adeɛ awia, na anwummerɛ no, mede me nsa tuu ɔfasuo no mu tokuro, na anim rebiribiri no, mede firii adi bɔɔ akɔnkɔn wɔ wɔn anim.
8Ɛnna AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn anɔpa sɛ: 9Onipa ba, Israel fie, atuatefoɔ fie no, nka nkyerɛɛ wo sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woreyɛ yi? 10Ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Adesoa yi fa ɔberempɔn a ɔte Yerusalem ne Israel fie a wɔwɔ wɔn mu no nyinaa ho. 11#Hes 12.6 Ka sɛ: Mene mo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ; sɛdeɛ meyɛeɛ no, saa na wɔbɛyɛ wɔn, otukorɔ mu, nnommumfa mu na wɔbɛkorɔ. 12#Yer 39.7 Na ɔberempɔn a ɔwɔ wɔn mu no, anim rebirie no, ɔde n’adesoa bɛto ne kɔn ho, na wafiri adi; ɔfasuo mu na wɔbɛtu tokuro sɛ wɔrefa mu afiri adi; ɔbɛkata n’ani na wamfa n’ani anhunu asase no. 13#Hes 17.20; 32.3-6 Na mede m’asau bɛgu ne so, na wɔayi no me fidie mu, na mede no akɔ Babel, Kaldeafoɔ asase so. Na ɛno mpo ɔrenhunu, na ɛhɔ na ɔbɛwuo. 14Na wɔn a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia sɛ wɔbɛboa no nyinaa ne n’asafo nyinaa, mɛbɔ wɔn apete mframa nyinaa ano, na matwe nkrantɛ adi wɔn akyi. 15Na sɛ mesunsum wɔn kɔ amanaman mu, na mebɔ wɔn pete nsase so a, wɔbɛhunu sɛ mene AWURADE. 16#Hes 6.8 Na mɛgya wɔn mu nnipa kakraa bi afiri nkrantɛ ne ɛkɔm ne owuyadeɛ ano, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔaka wɔn akyiwadeɛ no nyinaa, amanaman a wɔkɔ hɔ no mu, na wɔahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.
Wɔntuu atemmuo nhyɛɛ da
17Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 18Onipa ba, fa ahopopoɔ di w’aduane, na fa ahopopoɔ ne awerɛhoɔ nom wo nsuo. 19Na ka kyerɛ asase no so aman no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn ka no Yerusalemfoɔ a wɔwɔ Israel asase soɔ no ho nie: Wɔde awerɛhoɔ na ɛbɛdi wɔn aduane, na wɔde ahodwirie bɛnom wɔn nsuo, ɛsiane sɛ n’asase adane afo na ne mayɛ abɔ no, ɛsofoɔ nyinaa mmusubɔ no nti. 20Na nkuro a wɔtete mu no bɛsɛe, na asase no adane afo, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.
21Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 22#2 Pe 3.4 Onipa ba, abebusɛm bɛn na mowɔ no Israel asase so sɛ: Nna no rekyɛ, na adehunu nyinaa reyera? 23#Hab 2.3 Ɛno nti, ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Mɛma abebusɛm yi to atwa, na wɔremmu no Israel mu bio; na mmom kasa kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Nna no ne adehunu nyinaa asɛm abɛn. 24Na adehunu hunu biara ne atorɔ nkɔmhyɛ biara rentena Israel fie bio. 25Na mene AWURADE, na mɛkasa; asɛm a meka no, na ɛbɛyɛ hɔ, wɔrentwe nkɔ akyiri bio: O atuatefoɔ fie, mo berɛ aso ara, na mɛka asɛm na mɛyɛ, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.
26Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 27Onipa ba, hwɛ, Israel fie ka sɛ: Adehunu a ɔhunu no bɛba nna bebree akyi, na ɛberɛ a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri ho nkɔm na ɔrehyɛ. 28Ɛno nti ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Wɔrentwe me nsɛm mu biara nkɔ akyiri bio; asɛm a meka no, wɔbɛyɛ, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
